title: Countdown
description: Build a while loop with a condition that eventually becomes false.
solution:

    print(number)
    number -= 1

title: Sum until ten
description: Build a while loop with a condition that eventually becomes false.
solution:
total = 0
number = 1
while number <= 4:
    total += number
    number += 1
print(total)

title: Count digits
description: Build a while loop with a condition that eventually becomes false.
solution:
number = 5821
count = 0
while number > 0:
    count += 1
    number //= 10
print(count)
